purpose: Canonical Hero identity contract for the shared Hero-Soldier Relation Layer.

canonicalKey.role: Only canonical JOIN key for Hero identity across the shared relation layer

identityRules: All Hero <-> Soldier relation edges must reference Hero by heroId.
Hero names must never be used as JOIN keys.
nameKr, nameCn, nameEn and aliasesKr are display, review or search metadata only.
SPHeroInfo.ID is interpreted as the owning canonical Hero ID for Hero-Soldier relation work.
HeroInformation_ID and other metadata IDs must not replace heroId as the canonical Hero key.
Numeric patterns, name similarity and ordering must not be used to infer Hero identity.
A relation edge whose heroId is absent from the canonical Hero master must fail integrity validation rather than being silently accepted.

siteHeroId.rule: May be introduced later for site-specific needs, but must map back to heroId and must not become a ConfigData JOIN key.

slug.rule: May be derived later for URLs, but must be treated as presentation/routing metadata only.

completion: A-1 is complete when all later relation schemas and builders are required to use heroId as the sole canonical Hero identity key.
